resources.string: Questions about your screen and camera
When a computer asks to see your screen or your camera
Stays for as long as your screen or camera is shown on a computer
It sees everything on your screen until you stop it. A notification stays and you can stop it there at any time.
It sees what your camera sees until you stop it. A notification stays and you can stop it there at any time.
Tandem needs the camera for this. Allow it in the settings of the phone.
Which camera? It opens in a window on the computer.
Screen capture is kept ready for a few minutes, so showing the screen again needs no question. Tap Stop to end it
The computer cannot be reached right now
%1$s did not open the window. Try again from the computer.
The computer opens it in a window. You can stop it any time.
In a window on the computer. It is not a virtual webcam.
Says who is looking and has a Stop button. Needs permission to show over other apps.

Lets a computer you allowed click and type on this phone while it shows the screen. Nothing happens until you start sharing the screen and the computer asks for control. Tandem reads nothing from the screen except the field that is being typed in.
On. A computer you allow can click and type while it shows this screen.
Off. It can look at the screen but not touch it. Turn on Tandem control in Accessibility settings.
What plays on this phone plays on the computer too. Android asks first, every time
The sound of this phone is playing on the computer now
